label: College Football Playoff · teams

clips_and_posts.text: College football will expand its playoff to 24 teams beginning next year in a move that resets decades of tradition surrounding a once all-important regular season and dumps conference championship showdowns that used to be among the sport’s marquee events. #CFB #CollegeFootball #Football

note: Sides are one maintainer's judgment, not facts. 'First' means first among the tracked outlets, using feed publish times. The label is made of words the outlets' headlines share, not any one outlet's headline. last_updated is when a report was added or a headline changed. See methods.html.
